title: Captain Marvel, the flying heroine.
lines: She flies fast planes high in the sky.
When Carol was little, she fell over a lot.
But Carol got up again every time.
She brushed the dust off her knees.
One day Carol was flying a very special plane.
There was a magic energy inside it.
Carol was hit by the light.
When she woke up, she was different.
She could shoot light from her fists.
Carol got a suit in blue, red and gold.
With a gold star on her chest.
Now she was called Captain Marvel.
She flew through space, past the stars and the planets.
One day she heard a distress call.
A spaceship full of little creatures was in danger.
The ship was falling towards a sun.
She pushed the spaceship with her hands.
She thought of all the times she had fallen.
And all the times she had got up again.
I can do it, she said.
Slowly, away from the hot sun.
Captain Marvel flew back to Earth.
A girl had just fallen off her bike.
Do you know the secret of a hero?
But you always get up again.
The girl smiled, got on her bike and rode away.
